fields.name: imageUrl
fields.description: Product image URL used for comparison with the patent database (maximum 1,000 characters)

fields.name: queryMode
fields.description: Search mode: physical for product-photo search, line for line-drawing search, or hybrid for combined search. Maximum 1,000 characters

fields.name: regions
fields.description: Country or region codes where the product is sold, separated by commas, for example US,EU,CN. Supported values: US, EU, CN, JP, KR, DE, GB, FR, IT, AU, CA, BR, MX, IN, TH, SE, CH, IE, IL, DK, NZ, AT, BX, FI, and WO. Maximum 1,000 characters

fields.name: productTitle
fields.description: Product title used to provide additional search context (maximum 1,000 characters)

fields.name: productDescription
fields.description: Product description used to provide additional search context (maximum 1,000 characters)
fields.example: A protective smartphone case with a magnetic ring stand and shockproof corners.

fields.name: patentStatus
fields.description: Patent-validity filter: 1 for active patents, 0 for inactive patents, or 1,0 for all patents. Maximum 1,000 characters

fields.name: enableRadar
fields.description: Whether to enable AI radar analysis for potential infringement

fields.name: topLoc
fields.description: Top-level LOC classes to search, for example 06,07. Pattern: ^(0[1-9]\

fields.name: sourceLanguage
fields.description: Source-language code used to translate content into English, for example zh-CN. Leave empty when the text is already English. Maximum 1,000 characters

example.productDescription: A protective smartphone case with a magnetic ring stand and shockproof corners.
